title: A Study of the Prevalence of Headache in Epileptic Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the prevalence, characteristics and classification of headaches in epileptic patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a recent diagnosis epilepsy
* Able to describe their symptoms by themselves
* Have had at least 2 episodes of seizures during the previous year
* Have had at least 1 headache during the previous year

Exclusion Criteria:

* Well-controlled epileptic patients taking anti-epileptic medications
study_population: Patients with a recent diagnosis epilepsy; able to describe their symptoms by themselves; have had at least 2 episodes of seizures during the previous year; have had at least 1 headache during the previous year.
